title: 10/17 shoot: reaction clips
intro: What is left after your 10/12 cuts, with the exact times now in the shoot doc, plus three new retatrutide clips to choose from.
decided: Your one decision here is the retatrutide clip. My pick is the VladTV one, because it starts on "I advocate for retatrutide" and stays on it. Press "Use this one" on another if you like it better, or tell me to kill the short.
I have not touched the Retatrutide script. Once you choose, I put the clip in, check the script still fits it and stays under 66 seconds, and rebuild the teleprompter.

Two more I looked at and left off: his line "My favorite thing is going to be retatrutide" (strong, but I could only find it on a 4,000 view reaction channel with music over it), and Bradley Martyn's podcast, where he says he takes 15 mg (771,000 views, but he trails off into other drugs).
Everything else on this page is already decided and in the shoot doc, the Reaction Clips document and the teleprompter. One card each, to watch from.

Taken out on your word: Charles Barkley, the doctor's Ozempic face clip, the Elon Musk posts, and nine shorts (Worst Ab Workouts, the Zepbound doctor, and the Clavicular GLP-1, Nose Job, Hammer, Tan, Sunscreen, Supplements and Eyebrows shorts).
Bryan Johnson: you did not say keep or kill, and every clip but the opener was dead, so I took the whole video out of this shoot. The script is saved if you want it back.
The Tracy Morgan quote and the cortisol TikTok have nothing to pick.
check_title: Script lines the clips do not back up (your call: change the line, change the clip, or leave it)
check: Sharon Osbourne: the script says 42 pounds in about four months. The E! clip says 42 pounds in a year.
Meghan Trainor: the two quotes in the script ("we don't lose muscle..." and "We stay in the gym") are not in this ET video. It only reads out her post saying she used Mounjaro.
Oprah: the script says 20 pounds and "a lifetime thing". In this video she says she gained 15 pounds, and "a lifetime thing" is not said.
